departure.speaker: liam
departure.text: You're leaving the point on, aren't you?

departure.speaker: mira
departure.text: The point stays. I'm fastening the handle, remember?

departure.speaker: mira
departure.text: And he can check again when he comes back. I'll leave the drawing beside it.

departure.speaker: liam
departure.text: Do we have to wait here?

departure.speaker: mira
departure.text: You don't have to stand here watching me. I'll be getting on with my work, too.

departure.speaker: caelan
departure.text: Halden's busy with the festival flour. We could go past the mill.

departure.speaker: tomas
departure.text: It's turning again. You'll see it from the path.

departure.speaker: mira
departure.text: Stay on that path. Ask Halden where it's safe to stand.

departure.speaker: caelan
departure.text: And we stay together, like your mum asked.

departure.speaker: liam
departure.text: Can I look at the frame once more?

departure.speaker: mira
departure.text: Of course. There it is. I'll take care of it.

departure.speaker: mira
departure.text: See you, all three of you.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: There you are again, Caelan. And you've brought an audience.

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: Only a small one. Is this a bad time?

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: You'll be out of my way there. Liam, keep this side of me.

mill_arrival.speaker: liam
mill_arrival.text: Is it all right if I watch?

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: From there, yes. You can see the wheel well enough.

mill_arrival.speaker: liam
mill_arrival.text: Does it grind everything?

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: Grain. What were you planning to put in it?

mill_arrival.speaker: liam
mill_arrival.text: Nothing.

mill_arrival.speaker: tomas
mill_arrival.text: The wheel turns the machinery inside. The grain goes between the stones.

mill_arrival.speaker: liam
mill_arrival.text: So the water doesn't go in the flour?

mill_arrival.speaker: tomas
mill_arrival.text: No, it turns the wheel, and then the shaft—

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: You've answered him, Tomas. Let him look for a moment.

mill_arrival.speaker: tomas
mill_arrival.text: Oh. Right.

mill_arrival.speaker: liam
mill_arrival.text: It's bigger up close.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: And stronger than it looks. That's why you keep to the path.

mill_arrival.speaker: liam
mill_arrival.text: Mira said that.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: Then she's saved me repeating myself.

mill_arrival.speaker: caelan
mill_arrival.text: You've had a busy afternoon.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: A useful one, at least. Better than standing here looking at a wheel that won't move.

mill_arrival.speaker: tomas
mill_arrival.text: I'm glad it's working.

mill_arrival.speaker: halden
mill_arrival.text: So am I, lad. So am I.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: Is all that flour for tomorrow?

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: A fair bit of it. Bread first, then whatever else people have promised to bake.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: Buns?

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: I supply the flour. You'll have to ask the people doing the baking.

mill_flour.speaker: tomas
mill_flour.text: He knows which table he's going to first.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: Mum said I have to eat something else before the sweet things.

mill_flour.speaker: caelan
mill_flour.text: She may have noticed what you chose last time.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: There was bread in it.

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: (chuckling) Best take that argument to your mother.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: Who gets the bread you make?

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: The bakers make it. But at the shared tables, whoever comes can have some.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: Even if they didn't bring anything?

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: Yes. Someone brings bread, someone brings a pot of something. Someone puts out the benches.

mill_flour.speaker: caelan
mill_flour.text: And some people have their hands full at home.

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: There'll be loaves to send round to people who can't come, too.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: Do they still get the nice kind?

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: (glancing at him) What kind were you planning to leave them?

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: I didn't mean— I just wondered.

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: I know. Yes, they get good bread.

mill_flour.speaker: tomas
mill_flour.text: I can help with the benches tomorrow.

mill_flour.speaker: caelan
mill_flour.text: You offered Serene already.

mill_flour.speaker: tomas
mill_flour.text: I haven't forgotten.

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: Good. Leave the sacks to the people with carts. You've done enough moving them for me today.

mill_flour.speaker: caelan
mill_flour.text: We'll let you get on. Thank you for letting us stop.

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: Off you go. And Liam—ask before you go near any machinery.

mill_flour.speaker: liam
mill_flour.text: I did ask.

mill_flour.speaker: halden
mill_flour.text: You did. Keep doing it.

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_mother
venn_arrival.text: Caelan! Come in. There's room if you don't all stand in the doorway.

venn_arrival.speaker: caelan
venn_arrival.text: We were looking at the preparations. Would a short visit be welcome?

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_mother
venn_arrival.text: A short one, yes. It's good to have something else to talk about.

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_father
venn_arrival.text: And something else to do. I've had enough of waiting beside that road.

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_father
venn_arrival.text: I did. It's been useful already. I'm glad that business is settled.

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_child
venn_arrival.text: Something to hang up. I picked those colors.

venn_arrival.speaker: liam
venn_arrival.text: I'm making a lantern. It's a tower.

venn_arrival.speaker: liam
venn_arrival.text: Mira's got it. The handle tipped at first, but we moved it.

venn_arrival.speaker: liam
venn_arrival.text: And there's going to be stairs on the paper. All the way round, I think.

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_child
venn_arrival.text: Can you show me when it's finished?

venn_arrival.speaker: liam
venn_arrival.text: Yes. What are the colors for?

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_child
venn_arrival.text: Mum's tying the pieces together. That one goes next.

venn_arrival.speaker: venn_child
venn_arrival.text: No, the yellow. Then the blue.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: You can finish choosing this part. Then you're resting.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: I am resting.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: (gently) You know what I mean.

venn_preparations.speaker: liam
venn_preparations.text: Do you want both yellow ones together?

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: One here. One at the other end.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: All right. I'll keep them there while I tie this.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: Can I do that bit?

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: Let me manage the ties today. You tell me where each piece goes.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_father
venn_preparations.text: It'll look well over the window. We can see it from here.

venn_preparations.speaker: liam
venn_preparations.text: Are you putting it up here, then?

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: Can I carry it to the festival?

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: We'll see how you feel tomorrow.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: You said that already.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: I know, love. I still can't promise.

venn_preparations.speaker: caelan
venn_preparations.text: If you stay here, would you want someone to bring food over?

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: That would be welcome. I'll speak to Serene when we know.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_father
venn_preparations.text: We can hear some of the singing from the path. If it's a quiet evening, we might sit by the open door.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: I want to see the lights.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: I know. We'll do what we can.

venn_preparations.speaker: liam
venn_preparations.text: I can still show you the tower.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: With the stairs?

venn_preparations.speaker: liam
venn_preparations.text: If I can make them fit.

venn_preparations.speaker: tomas
venn_preparations.text: There's quite a lot of stairs in the drawing.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_child
venn_preparations.text: (a small laugh) I want to see it.

venn_preparations.speaker: caelan
venn_preparations.text: We'll give you some quiet now. Thank you for letting us visit.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_mother
venn_preparations.text: Thank you for coming. You three enjoy your afternoon.

venn_preparations.speaker: venn_father
venn_preparations.text: Elira will be getting her lantern ready, if you're going that way.

venn_preparations.speaker: liam
venn_preparations.text: Can we see hers?

venn_preparations.speaker: caelan
venn_preparations.text: We can ask. She may like some company.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: You've brought company, Caelan. Come in.

elira_welcome.speaker: caelan
elira_welcome.text: Hello, Elira. We were hoping we wouldn't interrupt.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: Only my thoughts. They can wait a little.

elira_welcome.speaker: tomas
elira_welcome.text: Liam's been showing us how to build a tower.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: Did she? What sort of tower?

elira_welcome.speaker: liam
elira_welcome.text: A lantern one. You can carry it, and it's got a point on top.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: And where are you keeping this tower?

elira_welcome.speaker: liam
elira_welcome.text: At the workshop. Mira's making sure the handle stays where we put it.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: A sensible place to leave it, then.

elira_welcome.speaker: liam
elira_welcome.text: I wanted it higher, but it'd be too heavy.

elira_welcome.speaker: tomas
elira_welcome.text: We talked about that for a while.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: You'll have to show me when the paper's on. I should like to see it.

elira_welcome.speaker: elira
elira_welcome.text: It is. Caelan brought it down for me earlier.

elira_lantern.speaker: liam
elira_lantern.text: Have you had it a long time?

elira_lantern.speaker: elira
elira_lantern.text: A good while. It needs a little looking after.

elira_lantern.speaker: elira
elira_lantern.text: Not this one. I've checked it, too.

elira_lantern.speaker: liam
elira_lantern.text: Mine's in the right place. Mira said.

elira_lantern.speaker: elira
elira_lantern.text: Then we'll both be able to carry them tomorrow.

elira_lantern.speaker: liam
elira_lantern.text: Are you making a new one as well?

elira_lantern.speaker: elira
elira_lantern.text: No. This is the one I want to take.

elira_lantern.speaker: elira
elira_lantern.text: He helped me mend it. He liked telling me how he would have done it.

elira_lantern.speaker: elira
elira_lantern.text: Sometimes. I tried not to make too much of those occasions.

elira_lantern.speaker: caelan
elira_lantern.text: You said he came to hear you sing.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: He got the last line wrong every year.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: Of course I told him. He said he knew the words perfectly well.

elira_memory.speaker: tomas
elira_memory.text: And then he sang it wrong again?

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: Louder. As though I might have misheard him.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: He put a garden gate in it once. I asked him which song he thought we were singing.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: (laughing) That he couldn't remember the words with me interrupting.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: Everyone standing near us. Some of them began waiting to hear what he'd do.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: He pretended to be. He always joined in again.

elira_memory.speaker: elira
elira_memory.text: (her voice softening) Yes. So do I.

elira_company.speaker: elira
elira_company.text: A little. I'd have liked to hear him get it wrong again.

elira_company.speaker: caelan
elira_company.text: Would you like us to stay a little?

elira_company.speaker: elira
elira_company.text: That's a pleasant thing to hear from you, Tomas.

elira_company.speaker: tomas
elira_company.text: (a little embarrassed) I'm not always in a hurry.

elira_company.speaker: elira
elira_company.text: How did your mother get on with all that paper, Liam?

elira_company.speaker: liam
elira_company.text: Ada got her sleeve stuck to some.

elira_company.speaker: tomas
elira_company.text: I held the paper while she tried to get it off.

elira_company.speaker: liam
elira_company.text: Mum said we should let it dry.

elira_company.speaker: caelan
elira_company.text: Your mum had us helping before we'd got through the door.

elira_company.speaker: liam
elira_company.text: Are you still going to sing tomorrow?

elira_company.speaker: elira
elira_company.text: Some will. Some would rather listen.

elira_company.speaker: elira
elira_company.text: I'd like that. Liam, bring your tower where I can see it.

elira_company.speaker: liam
elira_company.text: All right. I'll show you the stairs as well.

elira_goodbye.speaker: tomas
elira_goodbye.text: I could carry your lantern down for you tomorrow.

elira_goodbye.speaker: elira
elira_goodbye.text: Thank you. I'd like to carry this one myself.

elira_goodbye.speaker: elira
elira_goodbye.text: You can mind the door when I bring it out. It catches when I've got both hands full.

elira_goodbye.speaker: caelan
elira_goodbye.text: Then we'll see you tomorrow. Will you be all right here?

elira_goodbye.speaker: elira
elira_goodbye.text: Yes, Caelan. Thank you for the company.

elira_goodbye.speaker: liam
elira_goodbye.text: Thank you for showing me your lantern.

elira_goodbye.speaker: elira
elira_goodbye.text: You're welcome, love. I'm glad you asked.

elira_goodbye.speaker: liam
elira_goodbye.text: Mira hasn't put the paper on mine yet.

elira_goodbye.speaker: elira
elira_goodbye.text: There's still time today. Let her finish the part she's doing.

elira_goodbye.speaker: tomas
elira_goodbye.text: We'll leave you to get ready.

elira_goodbye.speaker: elira
elira_goodbye.text: Go on, then. And don't let that tower get away from you.

reflection.speaker: liam
reflection.text: Even if it makes her miss him?

reflection.speaker: caelan
reflection.text: Yes. I think she wants to.

reflection.speaker: liam
reflection.text: I want to show her the tower.

reflection.speaker: caelan
reflection.text: We will. Let's give her some quiet now.

departure_after.speaker: mira
departure_after.text: The frame and your drawing are safe here. I'll secure the handle before we fit the paper.

village_tomas_waiting.speaker: tomas
village_tomas_waiting.text: We're together. Take your time, Liam.

village_liam_waiting.speaker: liam
village_liam_waiting.text: Do you think everyone will have finished before tomorrow?

mill_before_visit.speaker: halden
mill_before_visit.text: Mind the wheel, you three. You can stand over here if you want to watch.

mill_after_visit.speaker: halden
mill_after_visit.text: There'll be plenty of flour. Now let the bakers have their turn worrying about it.

venn_before_visit.speaker: venn_mother
venn_before_visit.text: Hello, Caelan. It's been a quiet afternoon. We're keeping it that way as best we can.

venn_after_visit.speaker: venn_mother
venn_after_visit.text: We'll finish this little decoration, then it's time for some proper rest. Thank you for stopping in.

venn_child_after.speaker: venn_child
venn_child_after.text: Don't forget to show me the stairs on your lantern.

elira_before_visit.speaker: elira
elira_before_visit.text: Good afternoon, you three. There's room to come in if you'd like.

elira_during_visit.speaker: elira
elira_during_visit.text: Stay a little if you've time. It's good to have company.

elira_after_visit.speaker: elira
elira_after_visit.text: I'll see you tomorrow. Bring your lantern where I can have a proper look, Liam.

walk_after_mill.speaker: liam
walk_after_mill.text: Does Halden have to carry all those sacks?

walk_after_mill.speaker: caelan
walk_after_mill.text: He has people to help. Tomas and I moved some for him earlier.

walk_after_mill.speaker: tomas
walk_after_mill.text: I was glad when we finished.

walk_after_mill.speaker: caelan
walk_after_mill.text: You've been helping with your lantern already.

walk_after_venn.speaker: liam
walk_after_venn.text: What if they can't come tomorrow?

walk_after_venn.speaker: caelan
walk_after_venn.text: Then we can still visit another time. Let the family decide what they can manage.

walk_after_venn.speaker: tomas
walk_after_venn.text: They liked hearing about your tower.

walk_after_venn.speaker: liam
walk_after_venn.text: I talked a lot about it.

walk_after_venn.speaker: caelan
walk_after_venn.text: A little. You asked about their decoration, too.

walk_after_venn.speaker: liam
walk_after_venn.text: I liked the yellow at both ends.

village_after.speaker: liam
village_after.text: I hope Elira likes the stairs when I've finished them.

village_after.speaker: tomas
village_after.text: She wants to see them. You heard her.
